description: A final class implementing a filter to process header entries related to acknowledgment requests in the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It filters out internal acknowledgment requests from specified header values, handling JSON array parsing and filtering logic.

classes.name: DittoAckRequestsFilter
classes.description: An immutable singleton class that filters acknowledgment request headers, removing internal Ditto acknowledgment labels from specified header entries.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the DittoAckRequestsFilter.

methods.name: filterValue
methods.description: Filters the header value based on the key; specifically modifies acknowledgment request headers to remove internal labels.

methods.name: isRequestedAcks
methods.description: Checks if the provided key matches the REQUESTED_ACKS header key.

methods.name: tryToParseAsJsonArrayAndFilter
methods.description: Attempts to parse the string value as a JSON array and filter out internal acknowledgments.

methods.name: parseAsJsonArrayAndFilter
methods.description: Parses and filters the JSON array string, removing internal acknowledgement labels.

methods.name: isTwinPersistedOnly
methods.description: Checks if the value equals the string representing only 'twin persisted' acknowledgment requests.

methods.name: isLiveResponseOnly
methods.description: Checks if the value equals the string representing only 'live response' acknowledgment requests.

methods.name: isDittoInternal
methods.description: Determines if a JSON value corresponds to an internal Ditto acknowledgment label.
